description: Sets or clears the day a post is planned for in the calendar. Only the editorial date: nothing is scheduled or sent.

day.description: Day the maker wants to post it, YYYY-MM-DD, from today to 90 days ahead; null clears it. Only the editorial date: nothing is scheduled or sent.

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.
